TsBST and ROY.MARKET a Moscow non-profit, its military marketplace, and the drone-war supply around it

An open-source investigation of ANO «TsBST», a Moscow non-profit for the drone industry, and of the companies, products, sales and handovers to military units that connect to it. Every claim rests on an archived document and is graded by how well that document shows it.

What we found

  1. Reported

    A strike video, then a sales line

    TsBST re-posted a drone maker's footage of a strike and told servicemen they can order the two products used on its own marketplace.

  2. Documented

    A state bank and a donor foundation co-found it

    TsBST's registered co-founders are Bank PSB and the Nasha Pravda foundation, which has posted handovers of drone detectors to military units.

  3. Reported

    The ruling party sits above it

    TsBST names United Russia as a third founder, and the head of the party's central executive committee is secretary of its supervisory board.

  4. Reported

    Supply to a front the UN names

    TsBST's circle supplies and recruits for units of the formation the UN names in its finding on drone attacks on civilians in Kherson. Nothing on file shows an item used against civilians.

  5. Documented

    A platform that hides its operator

    ROY.MARKET's public terms print its operator as «****». An archived copy names MPTM, a company TsBST's own report to the Justice Ministry lists.

72 organisations are tied to TsBST on file; 26 of them are on a sanctions list.

A strike, then a sales line

On 19 October 2026 OOO «Gagaring»RussianООО «Гагаринг», a drone-electronics maker in Krasnodar, posted this short video to its Telegram channel:

Translation“And here is footage of the results of the Kuznechik and Sova 5.8 duo at work. […] The Zaporizhzhia administration's trident has come unstuck.”RussianА вот кадры результатов работы дуэта Кузнечика и Совы 5.8. […] У Запорожской администрации тризуб отклеился.Gagaring, Telegram, 19.10.20262

The next morning TsBST, the Moscow non-profit for the drone industry that counts the company among its residents3, posted the same video under its own headline, named the two products used, and closed with a sales line:

Their own words Reported“The trident came unstuck”: a TsBST resident showed footage of the strike on the Ukrainian administration of Zaporizhzhia […] The strike was carried out by a kamikaze drone using the «Kuznechik» communication system and the «Sova 5.8» remote video receiver. […] Servicemen can order them on ROY.MARKET, the specialised platform for dual-use goods.”Russian«Тризуб отклеился»: резидент ЦБСТ показал кадры удара по украинской администрации Запорожья […] Удар осуществлялся дроном-камикадзе с применением системы связи «Кузнечик» и выносного видеоприёмника «Сова 5.8». […] Военнослужащие могут заказать их на специализированной платформе товаров двойного назначения РОЙ.МАРКЕТ.TsBST, Telegram, 20.10.20264
  1. 8 OctoberZaporizhzhiaThe head of the regional administration reports that an FPV drone hit the coat of arms on its building.Reported
  2. neither post dates the strike
  3. 19 OctoberGagaringThe maker posts a video of “the results” of its Kuznechik and Sova 5.8.Reported
  4. same video
  5. 20 OctoberTsBSTRe-posts it as “a TsBST resident showed footage of the strike” and names both products.Reported
  6. sales line
  7. Order lineROY.MARKET“Servicemen can order them” there. The catalogue is behind a login, so TsBST's post is the only evidence.Reported

TsBST calls the city “occupied”. Zaporizhzhia is held by Ukraine; the building is the seat of its regional government. On 8 October the head of the regional administration reported that an FPV drone had hit the coat of arms on its façade: smoke, no fire, nobody hurt5. ROY.MARKET is TsBST's own marketplace for military units. No sanctions listing for the maker is on file.

Reported Both posts are the parties' own word. The video is consistent with the report of 8 October, but neither post dates the strike.

TsBST's “dual-use” is the platform's own label. From August 2026 its page for prospective sellers opened with “ROY.MARKET is a secure sales channel for dual-use goods.”RussianРОЙ.МАРКЕТ - защищённый канал продаж товаров двойного назначения.9 The copy archived on 12 October still did10. By 24 October the same sentence read “ROY.MARKET is a secure sales channel for special-purpose goods.”RussianРОЙ.МАРКЕТ - защищённый канал продаж товаров специального назначения.6 The kamikaze drone in TsBST's post used the two products it advertises; the platform's public terms and buyer offer use neither phrase.

What this does not show
  • A handover to a unit does not show that the equipment was used in combat. Some recipients are rear units.
  • TsBST's share in the company that runs ROY.MARKET is not stated in any document on file, and since 15.07.2026 the company register withholds who owns that company112.
  • A US sanctions entry under a similar name belongs to a different company registered in Tula. TsBST itself is not shown here as sanctioned by the US.

Who stands behind TsBST

The seller in that post is not an ordinary shop. TsBST's co-founders on the company register are a donor foundation and a state-owned bank; TsBST names the ruling party as a third, and the head of the party's central executive committee is secretary of its supervisory board.

Translation“TsBST together with United Russia and the Nasha Pravda foundation delivered thousands of items to the front for destroying the enemy. […] Together with the party and PSB we launched the military marketplace «Roymarket». The platform has been tested.”RussianЦБСТ вместе с Единой Россией и фондом «Наша правда» поставили на фронт тысячи изделий для уничтожения врага. […] Вместе с партией и ПСБ запустили военный маркетплейс «Роймаркет». Платформа протестирована.Aleksandr SidyakinRussianАлександр Геннадьевич Сидякин, secretary of TsBST's supervisory board and head of United Russia's central executive committee, on TsBST's year, Telegram, 15.12.202511

The front it supplies

In May 2025 the UN's Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Ukraine concluded that Russian drone operators on the left bank of the Dnipro had spent ten months attacking civilians in Kherson, and that the attacks amount to the crime against humanity of murder41. In October it extended the finding to 300 km of the river and three regions, and named the formation the operators serve in:

Quotation“They are affiliated with various army units, all of which are part of the “Dnepr” Group of Forces”UN report A/80/497, para. 40, 21.10.202542

The Commission names the 18th Combined Arms Army; it names no brigade. The Centre for Information Resilience and DW named the 205th motor-rifle brigade43 among three units whose drones worked over Beryslav during the attacks, while saying they could not prove who carried them out44. A channel that posts the brigade's footage places it in the 49th Army45. A senior doctor at a Kherson hospital told the Commission:

Quotation“Russian Federation soldiers behave like this is a safari […]; they are simply chasing and hunting civilians who are on their way to work or walking their dogs.”UN paper A/HRC/59/CRP.2, para. 42, 28.05.202541

What TsBST's circle says about that front

  • «Arkhangel» drone schoolTsBST's own channel says a resident's anti-drone simulator runs at the school's training centre in Tuapse46. The school's channel recruits operators for the 205th brigade47, which it calls “the terror of Kherson region”48. The school says it trains within Bars-Sarmat, Dmitry Rogozin's drone centre49.Not documented
  • Bars-SarmatIts commander, Dmitry Rogozin, says the centre fights for the commander of the Airborne Forces and that units of the «Dnepr» Group of Forces fit its munitions to their assault drones5051.Reported
  • Fond «Nasha Pravda»RussianФонд «Наша Правда»reports delivering 100 strike drones to fighters of the 49th Army on the Kherson direction in May 202452, and a vehicle now used by the 18th Army to move cargo and troops to the front line53.Reported
  • OOO «Gagaring»RussianООО «Гагаринг»the maker of the Kuznechik and Sova posts thanks from 49th Army air-defence crews who use the Sova to intercept drone video over the Dnipro54.Reported
Their own words Reported“Sign a contract with the Ministry of Defence and go on to serve in the drone unit of the 205th Guards Separate Motor Rifle Brigade. […] The final exam is your first combat mission, in which, under the eye of strict instructors, you will hit your first target.”RussianЗаключай контракт с Министерством обороны и неси дальнейшую службу в подразделении БПЛА 205-ой Гв ОМСБр. […] Выпускной экзамен - это Твое первое боевое задание, на котором Ты под присмотром строгих инструкторов поразишь свою первую цель.«Arkhangel», Telegram, 01.12.202547

DW's film on the Beryslav attacks shows the school too: over footage of men soldering a drone, watermarked with the school's channel address, the narration says “This Russian volunteer group proudly posts on Telegram” how it makes drones and trains operators43. The film does not say the school supplied the 205th.

The school's forum channel calls Kvadrosim, the simulator maker TsBST names as a resident, “our partners”, and says the heads of its Moscow branch, among them Anastasiya ShatrakovaRussianШатракова Анастасия Артёмовна, presented an interceptor called «Arkhangel» to a security agency together with that company55. TsBST's own post names an Anastasia Shatrakova as general director of the interceptor maker «Arkhangel», a finalist of its accelerator56. No document on file ties the school to TsBST.

More than a marketplace

TsBST presents itself as a support body for drone makers, and ROY.MARKET as a catalogue. Its own posts and its board secretary's describe more than that. It says it showed the marketplace at «Tsentr-2026», a strategic military exercise with delegations from 41 countries, and signed up sellers there:

Translation“The exercise was visited by the President of Russia, Vladimir Putin. […] During the exhibition, TsBST representatives agreed with more than 10 participants to place their range on the ROY.MARKET platform.”RussianУчения посетил Президент России Владимир Путин. […] В ходе выставки представители ЦБСТ договорились более чем с 10 участниками о размещении их ассортимента на платформе РОЙ.МАРКЕТ.TsBST, Telegram, 04.10.202671

On 15 October its board secretary, the United Russia official Aleksandr SidyakinRussianАлександр Геннадьевич Сидякин, announced an app that assigns incoming Ukrainian drones to mobile fire teams in Kursk region, and placed it inside a TsBST system:

Their own words Reported“This is part of the «Yakim» system, which was developed by TsBST and has been helping to control the region's airspace for a year now. […] In future we plan to link «Yakim» with the military system «Svod» for better analysis of the situation. We also want to connect automatic machine-gun turrets”RussianЭто часть системы «Яким», которая разработана ЦБСТ и уже год помогает контролировать воздушное пространство региона. […] В будущем планируем связать «Яким» с военной системой «Свод» для лучшего анализа ситуации. Также хотим подключить автоматические пулемётные турелиSidyakin, Telegram, 15.10.202673

Reported Both are the parties' own claims; no document on file shows the system in service.

A marketplace with a hidden operator

In December 2025 Sidyakin wrote that the party, Bank PSB and TsBST had launched a military marketplace. In August 2026 it opened to outside sellers and named the ones it wanted first:

Translation“The online marketplace ROY.MARKET has opened a protected sales channel for manufacturers, distributors and professional sellers of dual-use goods. First of all it invites legal entities already working on Wildberries, Ozon and other universal marketplaces.”RussianОнлайн-маркетплейс РОЙ.МАРКЕТ открыл защищённый канал продаж для производителей, дистрибьюторов и профессиональных селлеров товаров двойного назначения. В первую очередь площадка приглашает к сотрудничеству юрлица, которые уже работают на Wildberries, Ozon и других универсальных маркетплейсах.ROY.MARKET's announcement, 13.08.2026102

The site hides its operator. An older copy does not

The platform's public terms print the operator as “OOO «****»”. A copy archived on 22.08.2026 names it: OOO «MPTM»RussianООО «МПТМ», INN 9714068459. TsBST's own report to the Justice Ministry lists the same company as one it has taken part in since the day it was registered.

Lines as printed in each document, rendered in English; the Russian original is under RU. The masked version shows the requisites only after login.

One outlet among several

«Bulat», a drone detector shown at Dronnitsa 2025, a showcase TsBST takes part in, is a case in point. Asked whether the new «Bulat» would go on ROY.MARKET, its maker answered:

Translation“All our products can be bought only from us on the site 3mx.ru or from our dealers.”RussianВсю нашу продукцию можно приобрести только у нас на сайте 3mx.ru или у наших дилеров.3mx, in its customer chat, 02.09.2026105

The detector is sold through dealers and sole traders, and a foundation that co-founded TsBST buys it and posts the handovers. No Wildberries seller carries the maker's INN, so a sanctions screen keyed on that identifier finds none of them.

How to read the evidence

  • Documented A primary document shows it: a register extract, a state contract, an annual filing, a trademark or patent record.
  • Reported One party's own word (its posts, its website, its listings), or the press. Donors' handover posts are graded here until a second source confirms them.
  • Not documented Drawn to complete the picture, but no document on file shows it. The line's own note says what is missing.

Red marks only a sanctions listing, and always names the regimes. Names appear as registered, in Russian; a company known by its brand is shown by the brand, with the registered name beneath it.

How this is made

  • Facts come from the original Russian documents, read in full: company register extracts, annual accounts, procurement records, trademark records, court filings and the parties' own Telegram posts and websites. Summaries and machine translations are leads, never sources.
  • Every document is archived and hashed when it is collected. Each note at the end of a page says what the document is and links to it where a public copy exists.
  • Pictures are evidence only for what they show, and each says who published it. Faces of people taking part are shown; nobody is named from a face.
Annex: how the investigation got here

  1. We had been watching Wildberries

    The investigation started as WB Watch, a tracker of military goods sold on Russia's largest consumer marketplace. It found a large, open trade in kit for the war. ROY.MARKET then invited “first of all” sellers already on Wildberries and Ozon: the seller base already mapped.

    7,666military-item listings
    89%shipped from Wildberries' own warehouses
    802sellers

  2. First guess: the usual sellers, plus TsBST's residents

    If the platform recruits Wildberries sellers, and TsBST runs a residency for drone makers, the likely suppliers are makers that are both. Every maker on file was checked against the Wildberries sellers by INN.

  3. The check missed the best case

    «Bulat» returned nothing, though it is on sale through dealers and sole traders. That is why the investigation follows products, from the maker to the units that receive them, rather than the platform.
